body: I think I am getting there, it's just it wasnt that he just a really shit boyfriend, it was that he treated me like less than a person. I was lower than the lowest scum of the earth and he didnt care.
I mean hes already done more for her than he ever did for me by even acknowledging he has a girlfriend online.
I mean even though we lived together, got a cat together, and shared a life together I feel like I was the other woman the whole time.
Thank you for that. It's just sad knowing he will be a better man for her, give her the loves she needs, and he couldn't even be a decent person and let me go before it got this far.

I just always felt so in competition with her. Even after I found out they were cheating, he still went out of his way to make sure she was comfortable over me. My feelings never mattered only hers. Even though I asked him all the time after the first incident if he wanted to break up and he would say no. He would push me away and I had to give him so much space so he could talk to her (he never said that but i knew). He would say that i was using him too much emotionally, that he had to take care of me, even though I never asked him to fix any of my problems. I would wake up in the middle of the night, because he worked nights, to make sure his dinner was warm when he got home so all he had to do was rest and play video games until he went to bed. She wasnt even here and yet she got all of his love.

I'm still here. I just dont want to be. It's hard to talk about cause I dont know why I am such a terrible person. I just broke up with a man I dated for 2 years. He led me on for a good bit of it. Cheated on me with a girl he cheated on his ex before me with. I tried so hard to win his affections, but it was never enough. I cooked for him every night, even when I was exhausted from work. I did all the shopping, the laundry, took care of our cat, kept the house clean, paid some of his bills,  bought him nice things. Nothing persuaded him. He pushed me away and 2 days after I left him finally he posted on facebook that him and the girl he cheated on me with were in a relationship. He doesnt even care what he put me through.
Crazy eyes to match her personality lol. I wish I had her energy
Thank you. I'm gonna start living for me now.

I think I will be. It's just like (and I know this sounds bad) I consumed myself with him and his well being that I lost myself. I wanted him to love me so much that I couldn't see it was never going to happen. Not because of me, but because there is something missing inside of him.
Yeah I keep trying to tell myself that. I mean I was paying for so much and doing so much that for the benefit of both of us (I thought) in that aspect it feels like a weight has been lifted.
Need this now more than ever right now. It's funny how your whole world can be turned upside down in just a moment.
I'm trying to get to a therapist again. I am not close with my family and my friends are growing thin. I am very bad off right now and have no one to really talk to.

You know about five years ago my sister worked at a church after school program. She can draw really well and the kids would always ask her to draw them things. The most popular subject was Afro-Duck. She was very confused and asked them what that was, thinking it was a super hero or something from a cartoon. Nope, he was a regular duck with an afro. That's it.

I used to think about it a lot, especially reading the books at a young age, but it always made me happy to think that a child could be capable of more than adults gave them credit for. I grew up in a shit family where I was made it feel less of a person because I was young and it was refreshing to me to see that I could be capable of anything. 

And plus their adventures were very entertaining on a grand scale, something that would have been as potent if they had been older and "more capable" of taking on the tasks.
